stayType: Large touring and camping park with pods
accommodation: 380 touring caravan pitches, 100 motorhome pitches, 60 tent pitches and five pods/cabins (Pitchup)
suitableFor: Families, tourers, campers and dog owners
parking: Parking at pitch, up to two cars
dogs: Allowed, on leads, up to two per pitch; dog-walking area on site
beachAccess: Combe Martin beach 3.1 miles; Woolacombe about 15 minutes' drive (Pitchup)
confirmedFeatures: Indoor heated pool, two bars, restaurant, takeaway, shop, play area, crazy golf, riding centre, woodland walks, Wi-Fi
overview: Stowford Farm Meadows is a large touring park at Berrydown near Combe Martin, part of the Park Holidays group. It has hundreds of pitches for caravans, motorhomes and tents plus a few pods, with an indoor pool, bars, a restaurant and a riding centre. It is inland, about three miles from Combe Martin.
surfTripFit: Not a Croyde base: Woolacombe is around 15 minutes' drive and Croyde further, so it only works for surfers happy to drive to the beach each day.
gaps: Official site stowford.co.uk blocked fetching; facts from Pitchup only. Location is Combe Martin, not Croyde – consider moving area. Board storage and season dates not stated.
